title: Preserve explicit log axis
description: A horizontal log retains axis z and fails the incompatible axis predicate.

steps.command: execute if block 2 64 2 minecraft:oak_log[axis=z] unless block 2 64 2 minecraft:oak_log[axis=y]

notes: Arena is preloaded by provisioning. Immediate command-state assertions; no client or elapsed-tick claim. Positive execute predicates return Test passed on vanilla 26.3; errors and empty output fail expectations.
